regions.description: Readable executive summary with five explicit content fields

native_generation_prompt:
Use case: scientific-educational. Create ONE premium static factual editorial illustration for a technical book, landscape 1200x630, white background. This is finished conceptual artwork, not an engineering source drawing. Visual thesis: A plain-language executive summary before final verification gives the owner a useful point to approve, redirect or stop long agent work.
Style: Graphite cross-hatching with red-pencil review; Orthographic overhead proof inspection; Graphite and crimson. An oversized single executive-summary proof sheet lies diagonally across an interrupted work ribbon, not a generic card dashboard. On the sheet exactly five large named fields make the review content visible: goal, changes, tradeoffs, risks and proposed checks. Each field contains its exact word label only, no invented example record or micro-writing. The incoming work ribbon stops at this sheet. Three clearly differentiated decision branches on the right lead to final verification, return for revision, or a blunt stopped end. The labels Approve, Redirect and Stop explain their meaning; approval alone reaches the verification page. A red-pencil bracket visibly marks the pause, without a hand, signature or completed-check success badge. White paper and refined graphite illustration; text architecture is integrated proof editing, not plaques.
Source-supported facts: The speaker requests an executive summary before the final verification phase so that work can be redirected. A manager-facing procedure can inspect goal, changes, tradeoffs, risks and proposed checks, then approve, redirect or stop. Human attention remains limited as agent trajectories lengthen; production speed alone is not the measure of coherent work.
Required exact visible text, once each, and no other characters: Goal | Changes | Tradeoffs | Risks | Proposed checks | Approve | Redirect | Stop | Final verification | Review practice. Integrate text with the mechanism, no repeated badge/cards. Priority labels Goal, Approve, Final verification at least 38px; other labels at least 28px at final export. All foreground and full glyphs must stay at least 60px inside all edges, preferably 72px. No figure frame or header outside the illustration. Geometry describes the intended location of actual objects and labels; never print metadata. Only draw these causal arrowheads at physical object ports: Approve to Final verification, tail (935,155), tip (1000,300). No unplanned arrows. Required informative parts: incoming work ribbon; interruption bracket; goal field; change field; tradeoff field; risk field; proposed-check field; summary evidence page; approval branch; redirect return branch; stop termination; final-verification page. These are one cohesive composition, never a panel collage. Preserve open background and a strong readable focal relationship at 320px. No people, body parts, humanoids, brands, logos, photos, fake writing, decorative strokes, generic dashboard, invented controls, unsupported quantitative encodings or success marks.
